notes: V3.61.204 TEST GOOGLE STT RESULT INDEX R1: based on V3.61.203 TEST. Husband Google STT now tracks SpeechRecognition final results by result index and commits each recognizer only once, preventing previously-final result slots from being appended again when Android Chrome re-emits the full results list. True repeated speech in different slots is preserved. Manual Start/Stop authority, no timeout/silence auto-translation, Chirp 3 default/core, Wife/General STT, translation/back-translation/SMART, P160A/G158A, TTS, Relay/Cloudflare/Cloud Run and retranslation behavior are unchanged.
